a: Accuracy is correct predictions / total predictions.
Precision is true positives / predicted positives.
Recall is true positives / actual positives.
F1 is the harmonic mean of precision and recall.
A confusion matrix counts true/false positives and negatives.
Regularization penalizes complexity to reduce overfitting.
Learning rate controls the step size of weight updates.
Batch size is how many examples are used per update step.
An epoch is one full pass over the training dataset.
Dropout randomly disables units during training to reduce overfitting.
